name: LayoodWapi for WooCommerce
author: layoodtechnologies

sections.description:
Your LayoodWapi account already connects to this store via the WooCommerce REST API (Store URL + Consumer Key/Secret, entered on your LayoodWapi WooCommerce settings page) — that connection alone covers order confirmations, shipping updates, cancellations, and review requests, and works without this plugin.

This plugin adds two things the REST API alone cannot see:

  • Real pre-checkout abandoned-cart tracking — captures a customer’s phone number the moment they type it at checkout, before any order exists at all.
  • Instant order-status events — fires the moment an order’s status changes on this site, instead of waiting for WordPress’s own background task scheduler (WP-Cron) to eventually deliver a webhook.

Both are additive — nothing breaks or changes if you don’t install this, and nothing breaks if you later remove it.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce, installed and active.
  • Classic (shortcode) checkout for the phone-capture feature specifically — WooCommerce’s newer block-based checkout isn’t supported yet for that one piece; order-status events work either way.
sections.installation:
1. On your LayoodWapi WooCommerce settings page, download this plugin’s .zip.
  2. In WordPress admin: Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin → choose the file → Install Now → Activate.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Integrations → LayoodWapi.
  4. Paste the Endpoint URL and API Token shown on your LayoodWapi WooCommerce settings page. Save.
